# REQ-AUD-18 AC2 — coverage exclusions for the auditor's Python (.github/agent/bin/), mirroring
# the Go gate's .github/policy/coverage-exclusions.txt. Checked by
# .github/agent/tests/coverage-check.py.
#
# One range per line:  <path>:<first>-<last>  <one-line reason>
# A range must exclude at least one unexecuted statement and NO executed one (the gate fails a
# stale or over-wide range). Only code that genuinely needs Anthropic's endpoint or a real
# GitHub token / API may be excluded; everything else is tested. "An exclusion that hides
# testable code" is on the review loop's merge-blocker list.
#
# Measured scope: .github/agent/bin/ minus .github/agent/bin/tests/ (the tests themselves).
# fixtures/ holds test inputs, doubles and vendored PyYAML — test code, not auditor code.
#
# Whole-file entries: tracked .py under .github/agent/ that is NOT auditor code. The checker
# inventories every tracked .py there independently of the coverage config; each must be measured
# or listed here. `*` never crosses a `/`.
.github/agent/bin/tests/test_*.py  the unit tests themselves (test code — the Go gate does not measure _test.go either)
.github/agent/tests/*.py  the gate's own test infrastructure (coverage-check.py), exercised by the matrix suite's req18-ac2 case
.github/agent/fixtures/adjudicator/*.py  test doubles: stub adjudicator, fail-on-call adjudicator, fake GitHub API
.github/agent/fixtures/mutants/*.py  adversarial stand-ins the mutants harness installs in place of the auditor
.github/agent/fixtures/testlib/yamlshape.py  test-owned workflow-shape reader used only by the matrix suite
.github/agent/fixtures/testlib/pyyaml/*.py  vendored third-party PyYAML (upstream code, pinned copy, not auditor code) — also imported by auditor-consistency.py
